# Frequently asked questions

When does the front desk open? The desk opens at eight and does not close
until the last visitor has left. How do visitors get their badges? Badges
are issued at the desk. Do contractors wait in the lot? They wait where
the desk tells them to wait, and they get an escort at the gate.

When does the canteen restock? The canteen restocks on the last working
day, and the staff decide how much to order. How do customers reach the
duty manager? The duty manager answers the radio and the desk phone.
